# pangolin_ai_model (Resource)

Manages a model of an AI provider (Pangolin 1.22+): allows or blocks one upstream model key for the inference resources that use the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_ai_model" "gpt4o" {
  provider_id = pangolin_ai_provider.openai.id
  model_key   = "gpt-4o"
  name        = "GPT-4o"
}

# Refuse a model the provider would otherwise serve.
resource "pangolin_ai_model" "no_o1" {
  provider_id = pangolin_ai_provider.openai.id
  model_key   = "o1"
  name        = "o1"
  list_type   = "block"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model_key` (String) The model identifier sent upstream, e.g. `gpt-4o`. Unique per provider.
- `name` (String) The display name.
- `provider_id` (Number) ID of the `pangolin_ai_provider` the model belongs to. Changing it replaces the model.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the model entry is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `list_type` (String) `allow` lets clients use the model, `block` refuses it. Defaults to `allow`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric model ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an AI model by its numeric ID.
terraform import pangolin_ai_model.gpt4o <model_id>
```
